method: Paired immutable checkpoint ba515b19f5815fd6ef33aa4f978502494b6722c5 versus Visual Correction V2 working tree: identical React/Vite-only servers (5207 baseline/5208 current), Chromium CDP 4x CPU throttle, median of 3 trials each, same 5-seller fixture and simulated server receipt/stat update. No branch checkout. Not physical hardware. Only the employee portrait sheet is predecoded in both variants. Neither the baseline champion sprite nor the current independent champion WebP is prefetched. Both paired showroom variants include their first-use hero load/decode cost. The additional production variant uses initials/uploaded identity policy and is reported separately, not substituted for the paired comparison. Historical seller-selector numbers use different runtime/server and sampling; the paired baseline is used for this comparison.

polling.notes: Steady state estimates excluding initial load, sales, retries, filters and clock boundary refreshes. Cadence/pause/resume are verified with virtual-clock browser and unit tests.

fightCenter.method: Actual React UI at 4x CDP CPU throttle, deterministic test payloads, median of 3 trials. Initial opens include navigation and lazy JS; tab switches include the actual Playwright click and visible DOM wait. Local development server, not physical cash-register hardware and not a production network benchmark.

idle.method: Actual Chromium CDP Performance and devtools.timeline Paint events, 4x CPU throttle, warm five-second idle windows with real advancing Date/one-second countdown, local mocked API. Baseline at START_HEAD vs current. Stage is enabled in all reported normal results and screenshots; the additional stage-disabled diagnostic measures incremental decorative layer cost only, never substitutes for the visible design. Single windows vary; TaskDuration includes browser main-thread work, not GPU power or physical cash-register CPU. No animated background assets are loaded; 4 decorative static i elements, gradient floor/architecture/lighting.

bundle.method: Identical React-only Vite production config; archived immutable START_HEAD vs current, emitted JS+CSS sum with each file gzipped. Not all lazy chunks are Home-loaded. Full Cloudflare build separately passed. No new package dependencies.
